description: Log a feed purchase and automatically increment feed assets inventory. Supports confirm and idempotency validation.

bags.description: Number of bags purchased (positive finite integer <= 10000)

confirm.description: Set to true to commit, false for dry-run preview

feedType.description: The feed formulation or label (e.g. 28% Gamebird Starter)

lbsPerBag.description: Weight per bag in pounds (defaults to 50, <= 5000)

name: log_feed_purchase
